segments.an8.14:1.1: “Aṭṭha ca [aṭṭha (syā.)], bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅke [assakhaluṅke (sī.)] desessāmi aṭṭha ca assadose, aṭṭha ca purisakhaḷuṅke aṭṭha ca purisadose.
segments.an8.14:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an8.14:1.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an8.14:2.1: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā?
segments.an8.14:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti.
segments.an8.14:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati.
segments.an8.14:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃyeva ajjhomaddati.
segments.an8.14:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhati, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti.
segments.an8.14:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅghati purimakāyaṃ paggaṇhati purime pāde.
segments.an8.14:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodalaṭṭhiṃ [patodaṃ (sī. pī.), patodayaṭṭhiṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] dantehi mukhādhānaṃ [mukhāṭhānaṃ (ka.)] vidhaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
segments.an8.14:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti.
segments.an8.14:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā [saṅkharitvā (ka.)] tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati.
segments.an8.14:9.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha assakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca assadosā.
segments.an8.14:10.1: [vibha.956]“Katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā?
segments.an8.14:10.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:10.3: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno ‘na sarāmī’ti asatiyā nibbeṭheti.
segments.an8.14:10.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ vatteti;
segments.an8.14:11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:11.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakaṃyeva paṭippharati –
segments.an8.14:11.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena!
segments.an8.14:11.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati;
segments.an8.14:12.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:12.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakasseva paccāropeti –
segments.an8.14:12.3: ‘tvaṃ khosi itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī’ti.
segments.an8.14:12.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rathīsaṃyeva ajjhomaddati;
segments.an8.14:13.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:13.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.an8.14:13.3: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhati, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti;
segments.an8.14:14.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:14.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno saṅghamajjhe bāhuvikkhepaṃ karoti.
segments.an8.14:14.3: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅghati, purimakāyaṃ paggaṇhati purime pāde;
segments.an8.14:15.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:15.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno anādiyitvā saṅghaṃ anādiyitvā codakaṃ sāpattikova yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
segments.an8.14:15.3: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodalaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukhādhānaṃ vidhaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati;
segments.an8.14:16.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:16.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno ‘nevāhaṃ āpannomhi, na panāhaṃ āpannomhī’ti so tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheṭheti [viheseti (pī. ka.)].
segments.an8.14:16.3: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā neva abhikkamati no paṭikkamati tattheva khīlaṭṭhāyī ṭhito hoti;
segments.an8.14:17.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
segments.an8.14:17.2: So bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evamāha –
segments.an8.14:17.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva [idaṃ padaṃ sīhaḷapotthake natthi] idānāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissāmī’ti.
segments.an8.14:17.6: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko ‘pehī’ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā tattheva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati;
segments.an8.14:17.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā”ti.

lines: Piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavattetīti khandhaṭṭhikena yugaṃ uppīḷitvā pacchimabhāgena rathaṃ pavaṭṭento osakkati.
Pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanatīti dve pacchimapāde ukkhipitvā tehi paharitvā rathakubbaraṃ bhindati.
Tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjatīti rathassa purato tayo daṇḍakā honti, te bhañjati.
Rathīsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvāti sīsaṃ nāmetvā yugaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pātetvā satthinā rathīsaṃ paharitvā.
Ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karotīti thalaṃ vā kaṇḍakaṭṭhānaṃ vā rathaṃ āropeti.
Khīlaṭṭhāyīti cattāro pāde thambhe viya niccalaṃ ṭhapetvā khīlaṭṭhānasadisena ṭhānena tiṭṭhati.
